stores.title: Stores
stores.settings_desc: Connect a store with a plugin and choose where an ingredient search looks first.
stores.desc: A store is connected with a plugin: a small service you run or find, that Nutreek asks for products, prices and availability. Open Food Facts stays a source like the others.
stores.no_key: Stores cannot be connected yet: whoever runs this instance has to set NUTREEK_SECRET_KEY, which seals the plugins' tokens.
stores.sources_hint: Drag to change the order, or use the arrows: a search starts from the first.
stores.off_desc: Local copy of the catalogue · built in
stores.name: Name
stores.token_keep: Leave empty to keep the current one
stores.delete_confirm: Disconnect {{.Name}}? Your ingredients stay, without their link to its products.
stores.what.title: What is a plugin?
stores.what.body: A service that talks to a store's site and answers Nutreek in JSON: search, product, availability. Nutreek ships none; the contract is in docs/store-plugins.md.
stores.what.private: By default only public addresses are reached. For a plugin on your own network, whoever runs the instance sets NUTREEK_STORES_ALLOW_PRIVATE.
stores.error.no_key: Set NUTREEK_SECRET_KEY first: it seals the token.
stores.error.url: The address must start with http:// or https://.
stores.error.invalid: A name, an address and a token are needed, and up to 5 stores can be connected.
stores.test.failed: {{.Name}} did not answer. Check the address and the token.
